metadata.source: UB deployment parameter sheet received 2026-09-20, corrected 2026-09-23: azimuths replaced with the site-documentation values (44.5/77.5/110.5/143.5, spaced one 33 deg beamwidth apart), confirmed by Luigi against the site map. The sheet's 61/127/241/241 are not boresights; 241 pointed away from the served area.

conventions.Ptx: conducted dBm at the antenna port; EIRP = Ptx + Gtx
conventions.downtilt: engine convention el_off = v_ang + downtilt, so a 1 deg mechanical DOWNtilt is written -1
conventions.frequency: channel centre in MHz; channel_low/high_mhz carry the real 20 MHz channel
conventions.bandwidth_mhz: carried into the engine: it sets the thermal noise floor, N_RB for RSRP/RSRQ, the ACI channel width and the Shannon throughput for points served by this antenna

unconfirmed: Exact antenna part number. Bob: 'Mark just said it was an AW3647'; the T-variant and port count are being confirmed with Mark. The datasheet Luigi supplied (AW3647-T4-F) gives 19.5 dBi, 33 deg azimuth, 7 deg elevation, >27 dB F/B.

Vertical pattern frequency. The vertical.pat installed 2026-09-23 measures 9.4 deg elevation HPBW against the datasheet's 7 deg; the file does not state which frequency (or which of the vendor's per-frequency cuts) it was derived from. Ask Bob.

Host building height. GlobalBuildingAtlas gives 53.49 m for the footprint the site falls in, but 33.53 m AGL minus that is -20 m, and the site photograph shows the panels roughly 2-3 m above the roof deck. That puts the real roof near 30-31 m, so the GBA figure is wrong here by roughly 23 m. It is also the obstacle height the diffraction index carries for that footprint.

Channel-to-sector pairing: interleaved structure (co-channel sectors 66 deg apart) is carried by both pre-existing scenario files; which channel sits on which pair is unconfirmed. Swapping them changes free-space loss by 0.2 dB.

confirmed_2026_09_23.azimuths: site documentation values, confirmed by Luigi: 44.5/77.5/110.5/143.5, spaced one 33 deg beamwidth apart.
confirmed_2026_09_23.tilt: Bob: 0 deg electrical + 1 deg mechanical downtilt (i.e. the T0 variant). Matches downtilt=-1 in the engine convention.
confirmed_2026_09_23.power: Bob: the 29 dBm in the parameter sheet is the TOTAL across all four ports, not per port. EIRP = 29 + 19.5 = 48.5 dBm / 20 MHz = 45.5 dBm / 10 MHz, inside the Part 96 Category B limit.
confirmed_2026_09_23.height_reference: Luigi: 33.53 m is ABOVE GROUND LEVEL.
confirmed_2026_09_23.patterns: coverage_app/patterns/*.pat replaced with the 30-degree set supplied by Bob (derived from the manufacturer files). Measured on the files: azimuth HPBW 30.8 deg (datasheet 33), F/B within 180+-30 deg 28.4 dB (datasheet >27), elevation HPBW 9.4 deg (datasheet 7, see 'unconfirmed'), beam centre +0.6 deg below the horizon, consistent with the 0 deg electrical tilt of the T0 variant. The previous files (AW3023 H cut, 66 deg; V cut of unknown provenance) were removed; recoverable from git history before this change.
